INFORMATION & TRANSPARENCY

Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 18, 2026

This website is served as a static storefront and journal. The optional Saved products list uses browser local storage to keep product identifiers on your device; it does not create an account or transmit your saved list to us. We do not collect payment card details directly. When checkout is available, it takes place through an external payment provider. We may receive customer contact, shipping and order details from that provider and share the information necessary for order fulfillment with our supplier and delivery partners. Review this policy against your actual provider terms before enabling sales.

Our hosting provider may process routine server and request information as part of delivering the website. We also load example photography from Unsplash and web fonts from Google Fonts; those services can receive requests from a visitor's browser, including network information such as IP address. External websites we link to, including Pinterest and merchants if added later, follow their own privacy policies.

If we add analytics, forms, comments, advertising or affiliate network tracking, this policy must be reviewed and updated before those features go live. Additional rights or disclosures may apply depending on where visitors are located.

For questions about personal data, use the business contact information published on our Contact page once available.

This template is not legal advice. Review and tailor it before launching your business.
